_meta.scope: Japan: customs duty from the Japan Customs tariff schedule chapter 22 (applied MFN = Temporary rate where one exists, otherwise General/WTO), Liquor Tax from 1 Oct 2026, consumption tax 10% on CIF + duty + liquor tax.
notes: Wine MFN duty is '15% or ¥125/L whichever is less, minimum ¥67/L' — modelled exactly (ad_valorem_capped). EU, UK, Australia, Chile, CPTPP and other EPA origins are duty-free with a certificate of origin; not yet loaded.

Liquor Tax from 1 Oct 2026: beer-type unified at ¥155,000/kl; wine and sake ¥100,000/kl; spirits ¥370,000/kl up to 37% plus ¥10,000/kl per 1% above; liqueurs ¥120,000/kl up to 12% plus ¥10,000/kl per 1% above (verify liqueur base).
Beer customs duty: Free. Spirits: Free. Sparkling wine ¥182/L. Vermouth ¥69.30/L. Cider/perry treated as 'other fermented, other' ¥42.40/L (schedule text partly garbled — verify).
Consumption tax 10% (reduced 8% does not apply to alcohol). Not yet checked against an import declaration — tier official.

duty.label: Other fermented (cider, perry, mead, fruit wine) ¥42.40/L (verify)
